contract.ordinarySearch: Directional x/b/t with f/k/s swaps; Y/W with f/k/s swaps plus k->P or s->C to keep D exactly 2, with shared AEO R funding M42. Enumerate distinct retroflex placements on ESDFGHJKL containing E; score selected samples per allocation, then descend directional leaders.
contract.neighborhood: Final single moves, pair swaps, key-group swaps, and A/E/O single or co-key group moves. Prioritize b/n lane and overall lane, alternating axes. Finite search.
